mapper.select: SELECT PISD.BATCH_ID batchId, PISD.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, PISD.RATIO ratio, TEMP.EFF_DATE effDate FROM (SELECT STRATEGY_ID, PORTFOLIO_ID, MAX(EFF_DATE) EFF_DATE FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY WHERE EFF_DATE <=#{date,jdbcType=DATE} AND PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID, STRATEGY_ID ) TEMP INNER JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY PIS ON PIS.STRATEGY_ID = TEMP.STRATEGY_ID INNER JOIN PTL_INV_STRATEGY_DETAIL PISD ON PISD.STRATEGY_ID = PIS.STRATEGY_ID
